card.title: Authority on Paper
card.instruction: Project firm control through titles and procedure, then tighten the formalities whenever anyone tests whether your position has real support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As acting manager, I'm authorising everyone to stay late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That question needs to be submitted on company stationery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You printed this stationery this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I've already established a proper channel for challenging it.

beats.text: As acting manager, I'm authorising everyone to stay late.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You printed this stationery this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then attach a second form disputing the stationery's authority. I'll need both in triplicate before considering your appointment question.

mechanism: A uses acting-manager procedure to command overtime, then adds document requirements when the authority and stationery are challenged.
confusable: Unlike merely invoking formal authority, A must add formalities specifically when the claim's real support is tested.
comparison: The office alternative adds documentary hurdles; the drain alternative adds a nomination hearing and impossible seconding requirement.
